unchanged: Queue ordering, cancellation, ACK repetition, packing, preamble, slot/holdoff clocks, historical slot avoidance, IdleRts and actual transmission paths.
scope: Conditional MAC scheduling parity under common receiver availability; not a duty-cycle lifecycle test.
passive_observer: Emit the actual local reservation counter after each production decrement; no extra clock event, draw, or state change.

cancellation_boundary.native: CancelAcknowledgedFrames scans the queued window and excludes structured destination sequences.
cancellation_boundary.matlab: HOP Layer.receiveFeedback/complete filters control custody before calling MAC.cancel; calling MAC.cancel for every bitmap bit is not an equivalent boundary.
cancellation_boundary.adapter: replayCancelWindow selects only native-eligible actual queued keys, then calls unchanged production cancel. Ambiguous protected/unprotected keys abort.
cancellation_boundary.scope: Queue-cancellation intent is exogenous. This test does not validate HOP custody or group completion.
